name: ❄️ [Christmas] ❄️ Tensura Chronicles (Alpha Demo)
desc:
⚠️ Content is extremely limited at the moment! The currently published Alpha Build is being actively developed daily, with updates soon to be pushed out rapidly.

This is a now licensed game based off Tensura (That Time I got Reincarnated as a Slime)! It's a work in progress with the alpha demo currently being playable! All questions or concerns are welcome, if you dislike something don't hesitate to let us know!

- Controls -
[Dash] - Q/Xbox B
[Slots] - L1+R1/1-9
[Blocking] - F/Left Trigger
[Sprint] - Ctrl/DPad Down
[Menu] - M/DPad Up
[PlayerList] - Tab/DPad Left
